_comment: Measured CI offline hybrid baseline (deterministic pseudo-embeddings). Seeded automatically by scripts/ci_eval_retrieval.py on first main-branch run. Regressions beyond 2pp Hit Rate@5 / 0.02 MRR / 20% latency fail the gate. The 100% no-answer false-positive rate is expected with only 2 no-answer cases and deterministic vectors — the evidence gating needs real semantic embeddings to distinguish answerable from unanswerable queries.
